title: Create a 30-second ultra-photorealistic cinematic adventure video in 16:9…
content:
Create a 30-second ultra-photorealistic cinematic adventure video in 16:9 landscape. Use my uploaded face as the exact identity reference for the main lead climber. Preserve my facial identity, facial structure, skin tone, eyes, nose, lips, and natural appearance consistently throughout the entire video. I am the expedition leader, wearing realistic professional glacier-climbing gear, helmet, crampons, ice axe, harness, ropes, gloves, and a weatherproof jacket. A team of 4–5 climbers follows behind me. Realistic Himalayan glacier environment, towering ice walls, deep crevasses, blowing snow, dramatic mountains, natural physics, documentary-level realism, cinematic lighting, realistic camera movement, intense but believable human reactions. No face distortion, no identity changes, no extra limbs, no cartoon look.

0–3 sec: Extreme wide aerial shot of a massive Himalayan glacier surrounded by towering snow-covered peaks. The tiny climbing team moves across the enormous ice field. Camera rapidly pushes toward the team, establishing the scale and danger.

3–6 sec: Cut to a low-angle tracking shot of me leading the team, boots crushing fresh snow and crampons biting into blue ice. I grip my ice axe firmly and move forward with confidence. The team follows several meters behind.

6–9 sec: Close-up of my face. Wind blasts snow across my helmet and jacket. I look ahead intensely, scanning the glacier. Breath visibly condenses in the freezing air. I raise one gloved hand, signaling the team to stop.

9–12 sec: Camera moves over my shoulder to reveal a huge hidden crevasse directly ahead. The glacier suddenly groans and cracks. Small chunks of ice fall into the darkness. The team reacts with tension.

12–15 sec: I quickly secure the climbing rope around a solid ice anchor and carefully test the surface with my ice axe. A section of snow collapses nearby, revealing deep blue ice underneath. The camera shakes subtly from the impact.

15–18 sec: I begin crossing the dangerous section first, carefully placing each crampon. The rope stretches tightly behind me as the team follows. Camera circles around me, revealing the enormous crevasse beneath my feet.

18–21 sec: Sudden action: the snow beneath one of my feet partially breaks. I drop slightly toward the crevasse but catch myself instantly with both ice axes, stopping the fall. Snow explodes into the air. The team shouts and pulls the safety rope.

21–24 sec: Intense close-up of me gripping the ice axes, breathing heavily. I regain my footing, look back at the team, and give a confident signal to continue. My expression shows determination rather than panic.

24–27 sec: Dynamic drone shot rises dramatically above the entire expedition as we cross the glacier together. Huge mountains tower around us while a snowstorm begins approaching in the distance.

27–30 sec: Final heroic shot: I reach a high glacier ridge first and plant my ice axe firmly into the snow. The team arrives behind me. Camera slowly pushes toward my face as powerful wind blows snow around us. I look toward the vast mountain summit ahead. Cut to black at the peak of the moment.

Crea un video de aventura cinematográfico ultra fotorrealista de 30 segundos en formato horizontal 16:9. Usa mi rostro subido como referencia exacta de identidad para el escalador principal. Conserva mi identidad facial, estructura facial, tono de piel, ojos, nariz, labios y apariencia natural de forma consistente durante todo el video. Soy el líder de la expedición, y llevo equipo realista y profesional de escalada en glaciar: casco, crampones, piolet, arnés, cuerdas, guantes y una chaqueta impermeable. Un equipo de 4–5 escaladores me sigue detrás. Entorno glaciar himalayo realista, muros de hielo imponentes, profundas grietas, nieve soplando, montañas dramáticas, física natural, realismo de nivel documental, iluminación cinematográfica, movimiento de cámara realista, reacciones humanas intensas pero creíbles. Sin distorsión facial, sin cambios de identidad, sin extremidades extra, sin aspecto de caricatura.

0–3 sec: Toma aérea extrema en plano general de un enorme glaciar del Himalaya rodeado de picos imponentes cubiertos de nieve. El pequeño equipo de escalada avanza por el inmenso campo de hielo. La cámara se acerca rápidamente al equipo, estableciendo la escala y el peligro.

3–6 sec: Corte a una toma de seguimiento en ángulo bajo de mí liderando al equipo, con las botas aplastando nieve fresca y los crampones clavándose en el hielo azul. Sostengo firmemente mi piolet y avanzo con confianza. El equipo me sigue a varios metros detrás.

6–9 sec: Primer plano de mi rostro. El viento lanza nieve sobre mi casco y mi chaqueta. Miro al frente con intensidad, inspeccionando el glaciar. El aliento se condensa visiblemente en el aire helado. Levanto una mano enguantada, señalando al equipo que se detenga.

9–12 sec: La cámara se mueve por encima de mi hombro para revelar una enorme grieta oculta justo delante. El glaciar de repente cruje y se agrieta. Pequeños fragmentos de hielo caen en la oscuridad. El equipo reacciona con tensión.

12–15 sec: Aseguro rápidamente la cuerda de escalada alrededor de un anclaje sólido de hielo y pruebo con cuidado la superficie con mi piolet. Una sección de nieve se derrumba cerca, revelando hielo azul profundo debajo. La cámara tiembla sutilmente por el impacto.

15–18 sec: Empiezo a cruzar primero la sección peligrosa, colocando con cuidado cada crampon. La cuerda se tensa detrás de mí mientras el equipo me sigue. La cámara gira a mi alrededor, revelando la enorme grieta bajo mis pies.

18–21 sec: Acción repentina: la nieve bajo uno de mis pies se rompe parcialmente. Caigo ligeramente hacia la grieta, pero me recupero al instante con ambos piolets, deteniendo la caída. La nieve explota en el aire. El equipo grita y tira de la cuerda de seguridad.

21–24 sec: Primer plano intenso de mí sujetando los piolets, respirando con fuerza. Recupero el equilibrio, miro hacia atrás al equipo y doy una señal segura para continuar. Mi expresión muestra determinación, no pánico.

24–27 sec: Toma dinámica con dron que asciende de forma espectacular por encima de toda la expedición mientras cruzamos juntos el glaciar. Montañas gigantes se alzan a nuestro alrededor mientras una tormenta de nieve comienza a acercarse a lo lejos.

27–30 sec: Toma final heroica: llego primero a una cresta alta del glaciar y clavo firmemente mi piolet en la nieve. El equipo llega detrás de mí. La cámara avanza lentamente hacia mi rostro mientras un viento poderoso levanta la nieve a nuestro alrededor. Miro hacia la vasta cima de la montaña que tenemos delante. Corte a negro en el punto culminante del momento.

16:9の横長で、30秒の超写実的なシネマティック冒険動画を作成してください。メインのリードクライマーには、アップロードした私の顔をそのまま正確なアイデンティティ参照として使用してください。動画全体を通して、私の顔のアイデンティティ、顔の構造、肌の色、目、鼻、唇、そして自然な見た目を一貫して維持してください。私は遠征隊のリーダーであり、リアルなプロ仕様の氷河登山装備、ヘルメット、アイゼン、ピッケル、ハーネス、ロープ、手袋、そして防水ジャケットを着用しています。4〜5人のクライマーのチームが私の後ろをついてきます。リアルなヒマラヤの氷河環境、そびえ立つ氷壁、深いクレバス、吹雪、劇的な山々、自然な物理法則、ドキュメンタリー級のリアリズム、シネマティックなライティング、リアルなカメラワーク、激しいが信じられる人間の反応。顔の歪み、アイデンティティの変化、余分な手足、アニメ風の見た目は一切なし。

0〜3秒: そびえ立つ雪に覆われた峰々に囲まれた巨大なヒマラヤ氷河の、極端な広角の空撮ショット。小さなクライミングチームが広大な氷原を横切って進む。カメラが素早くチームへと寄り、スケールと危険性を示す。

3〜6秒: ローアングルのトラッキングショットに切り替わり、私がチームを率いて進む。ブーツが新雪を踏みつぶし、アイゼンが青い氷に食い込む。私はピッケルをしっかり握り、自信を持って前進する。チームは数メートル後方を追従する。

6〜9秒: 私の顔のクローズアップ。風がヘルメットとジャケットに雪を吹きつける。私は氷河を鋭く見据え、前方を集中して確認する。凍てつく空気の中で息がはっきりと白く見える。私は手袋をした片手を上げ、チームに停止の合図を送る。

9〜12秒: カメラが私の肩越しに移動し、真正面に巨大な隠れたクレバスが現れる。氷河が突然うなり、ひび割れる。小さな氷の塊が闇の中へ落ちていく。チームに緊張が走る。

12〜15秒: 私は素早くクライミングロープを確かな氷のアンカーに固定し、ピッケルで慎重に表面を確かめる。近くで雪の一部が崩れ落ち、その下に深い青色の氷が露出する。衝撃でカメラがわずかに揺れる。

15〜18秒: 私が先頭で危険な区間を渡り始め、アイゼンを一歩ずつ慎重に置いていく。後方ではロープが強く張り、チームが続く。カメラが私の周囲を回り込み、足元に広がる巨大なクレバスを見せる。

18〜21秒: 突然のアクション。私の片足の下の雪が部分的に崩れる。私はクレバスへわずかに落ちかけるが、両手のピッケルで即座に体を支え、転落を止める。雪が空中に爆発するように舞い上がる。チームが叫び、安全ロープを引く。

21〜24秒: ピッケルを強く握る私の緊迫したクローズアップ。私は荒い息を整え、足場を取り戻し、振り返ってチームに続行の自信ある合図を送る。表情にはパニックではなく、決意が表れている。

24〜27秒: ダイナミックなドローンショットが、氷河を渡る私たち遠征隊全体の上空へ劇的に上昇する。巨大な山々が周囲にそびえ立ち、遠くでは吹雪が近づき始める。

27〜30秒: 最後の英雄的なショット。私は高い氷河の稜線に最初に到達し、ピッケルを雪にしっかりと突き立てる。チームが後ろから到着する。強風が雪を巻き上げる中、カメラがゆっくりと私の顔へ寄っていく。私は前方の広大な山頂を見つめる。クライマックスの瞬間で暗転。

3–6초: 낮은 앵글의 트래킹 샷으로 전환되어, 제가 팀을 이끄는 모습이 나온다. 부츠가 تازه한 눈을 짓밟고 크램폰이 푸른 얼음에 박힌다. 저는 아이스 액스를 단단히 쥐고 자신 있게 앞으로 나아간다. 팀은 몇 미터 뒤에서 따라온다.

6–9초: 제 얼굴 클로즈업. 바람이 헬멧과 재킷 위로 눈을 세차게 날린다. 저는 앞을 강하게 응시하며 빙하를 살핀다. 차가운 공기 속에서 숨이 눈에 보이게 응결된다. 저는 장갑 낀 손 하나를 들어 팀에게 멈추라는 신호를 보낸다.

9–12초: 카메라가 제 어깨 너머로 이동해 바로 앞에 거대한 숨겨진 크레바스가 드러난다. 빙하가 갑자기 신음하듯 울리고 갈라진다. 작은 얼음 조각들이 어둠 속으로 떨어진다. 팀은 긴장한 반응을 보인다.

12–15초: 저는 빠르게 등반 로프를 단단한 얼음 앵커에 고정하고, 아이스 액스로 표면을 조심스럽게 시험한다. 근처의 눈층 일부가 무너지며 아래의 깊은 푸른 얼음이 드러난다. 충격으로 카메라가 미세하게 흔들린다.

15–18초: 저는 먼저 위험 구간을 건너기 시작하며, 크램폰 하나하나를 신중하게 디딘다. 팀이 뒤따르면서 로프가 팽팽하게 당겨진다. 카메라가 제 주위를 돌며, 제 발 아래 거대한 크레바스를 드러낸다.

18–21초: 갑작스러운 액션: 제 발 아래 눈이 부분적으로 무너진다. 저는 크레바스 쪽으로 약간 떨어지지만, 두 개의 아이스 액스로 즉시 몸을 지탱해 추락을 멈춘다. 눈이 공중으로 폭발하듯 튄다. 팀은 소리치며 안전 로프를 당긴다.

pt.content:
Crie um vídeo de aventura cinematográfico ultra-fotorrealista de 30 segundos em 16:9 horizontal. Use meu rosto enviado como referência exata de identidade para o alpinista principal. Preserve minha identidade facial, estrutura facial, tom de pele, olhos, nariz, lábios e aparência natural de forma consistente durante todo o vídeo. Eu sou o líder da expedição, usando equipamento profissional realista de escalada em geleiras, capacete, crampons, piolet, arnês, cordas, luvas e uma jaqueta impermeável. Uma equipe de 4–5 alpinistas me segue logo atrás. Ambiente realista de geleira do Himalaia, paredes de gelo imponentes, fendas profundas, neve soprando, montanhas dramáticas, física natural, realismo em nível documental, iluminação cinematográfica, movimento de câmera realista, reações humanas intensas, porém críveis. Sem distorção facial, sem mudanças de identidade, sem membros extras, sem aparência de desenho animado.

0–3 sec: Extreme wide aerial shot of a massive Himalayan glacier surrounded by towering snow-covered peaks. The tiny climbing team moves across the enormous ice field. Camera rapidly pushes toward the team, establishing the scale and danger.

3–6 sec: Cut to a low-angle tracking shot of me leading the team, boots crushing fresh snow and crampons biting into blue ice. I grip my ice axe firmly and move forward with confidence. The team follows several meters behind.

6–9 sec: Close-up of my face. Wind blasts snow across my helmet and jacket. I look ahead intensely, scanning the glacier. Breath visibly condenses in the freezing air. I raise one gloved hand, signaling the team to stop.

9–12 sec: Camera moves over my shoulder to reveal a huge hidden crevasse directly ahead. The glacier suddenly groans and cracks. Small chunks of ice fall into the darkness. The team reacts with tension.

12–15 sec: I quickly secure the climbing rope around a solid ice anchor and carefully test the surface with my ice axe. A section of snow collapses nearby, revealing deep blue ice underneath. The camera shakes subtly from the impact.

15–18 sec: I begin crossing the dangerous section first, carefully placing each crampon. The rope stretches tightly behind me as the team follows. Camera circles around me, revealing the enormous crevasse beneath my feet.

18–21 sec: Sudden action: the snow beneath one of my feet partially breaks. I drop slightly toward the crevasse but catch myself instantly with both ice axes, stopping the fall. Snow explodes into the air. The team shouts and pulls the safety rope.

21–24 sec: Intense close-up of me gripping the ice axes, breathing heavily. I regain my footing, look back at the team, and give a confident signal to continue. My expression shows determination rather than panic.

24–27 sec: Dynamic drone shot rises dramatically above the entire expedition as we cross the glacier together. Huge mountains tower around us while a snowstorm begins approaching in the distance.

27–30 sec: Final heroic shot: I reach a high glacier ridge first and plant my ice axe firmly into the snow. The team arrives behind me. Camera slowly pushes toward my face as powerful wind blows snow around us. I look toward the vast mountain summit ahead. Cut to black at the peak of the moment.
